title: Shift, Squeeze and Hold
format: Back four plus two midfielders v five attackers
area: 50m x 36m, one full size goal with keeper on the left, halfway line marked
kit: Red and Blue bibs, keeper in a third colour, balls in the goal
start: Red start with the ball in midfield, Blue hold a compact block

steps.say: Blue hold a compact block: back four on one line, two midfielders just in front.
steps.vo: Blue hold a compact block. A back four on one line, two midfielders just in front, and no big gaps between them.

steps.say: SHIFT: ball goes wide, the whole block slides across together.
steps.vo: Shift. The ball goes wide, so the whole block slides across together. The player nearest the ball is on it. Everyone else is a pass away.

steps.say: SQUEEZE: ball goes back. The line steps up and the space shrinks.
steps.vo: Squeeze. The attackers play it back. The line steps up four metres, and the midfielders step with them. The space shrinks.

steps.say: The switch comes. The block shifts back across, staying as one.
steps.vo: Now the switch. The ball travels to the other side. The block shifts back across, staying connected, with the line never breaking.

steps.say: HOLD: B4 shows R2 wide, B3 covers behind, B6 drops in to block the middle.
steps.vo: Hold. B4 shows the attacker towards the touchline. B3 covers behind him. B6 drops in to block the pass through the middle.

steps.say: R2 has nowhere to go. B6 steps in and wins the pass. Blue are ready to go.
steps.vo: R2 has nowhere to go. He tries the pass inside. B6 steps in front and wins it. Blue stayed together, so they win the ball without a single tackle.

setup: Blue defend the left hand goal: back four (B1 to B4), two midfielders (B5, B6) and a keeper.
Red have five attackers (R1 to R5) with a ball in midfield.
Cones mark a channel 10m wide either side so Blue can see the shift distance.
rules: Red may play anywhere but Blue score points for each win of the ball.
Blue get a point for every full shift where all six players move together.
Red score by getting a shot on goal from inside the area.
restart: Blue win the ball: they play it to a target player, then restart from the halfway line.
Ball out of play: Red restart from halfway.
points: Shift together: when the ball moves, we all move. Nobody stays behind.
Squeeze when it goes back: step up and make the pitch smaller.
Hold the line: stay the same distance apart, arms length when you can.
Talk early: name the ball player and say who covers.
progress: Add a sixth Red attacker so Blue must hold with fewer numbers.
Make the shift a time limit: the block has to move in three seconds.
Play 11v11 and award a point for every compact defensive phase.
